name: custom-kanban
title: Custom Kanban
description: A dark task board with Backlog, TODO, In progress and Complete columns. Cards are dragged from one column to another, counts update, and dropping on the trash zone deletes a card.
use: Tasks move through stages such as backlog, todo, doing and done by dragging cards between columns.
avoid: Drag only works with a mouse and the board scrolls sideways, so narrow screens and keyboard users are poorly served.
a11y: Cards move only by mouse drag and are not focusable, so the board cannot be operated from the keyboard, and the icons have no labels. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A charcoal full-screen board holding four narrow columns, each headed by a small coloured label and a number. Under each heading sit short dark cards with pale text, a faint outline and an 'Add card' line, with a square trash drop zone at the far right.
behaves: Dragging a card lifts it out of its column and shows a thin violet drop line between cards. Dropping drops it into the nearest gap and the column counts change; hovering a column tints its background and dragging onto the trash zone swaps the bin for a bouncing flame.
customise: Card titles and columns are fixed in a DEFAULT_CARDS array inside the file; colours, widths and headings all need source edits.
weight: light: A few dozen DOM nodes with one layout animation per drag; idle otherwise.
